copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 里安装并运行 claude-mem:默认启动本地 worker,由 MCP 服务 claude-mem-local 与它通信;也可改用远程 worker,通过 claude-mem-remote 连到你自己的服务器。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装配置 claude-mem 时使用,可选择本地或远程 worker、本机登录 observer 或 cmem.ai 远程推理。与 Grok Bot 无关,不需要另一个 IDE。

say.text: 在 Cursor 里安装 claude-mem,用默认的本地 worker
把 claude-mem 的 provider 改成 host,走本机登录
用远程 worker 安装 claude-mem,服务器地址是我的主机

howto.what_en: Installs and runs claude-mem inside Cursor: by default it starts a local worker that the claude-mem-local MCP server talks to; you can instead use a remote worker via claude-mem-remote pointed at your own server.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference. Independent of Grok Bot; the other IDE is not required.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem in Cursor using the default local worker
Switch claude-mem's provider to host and use my local login
say_en.note: Enables the loopback shim on port 37778

say_en.text: Install claude-mem with a remote worker at my host URL
